description.en: An early build of a portfolio showcase for a workspace-first enterprise HRIS, with company workspaces, role-based consoles, simulated payroll and an employee mobile app. All data stays in your browser.
description.id: Build awal showcase portofolio HRIS enterprise berbasis workspace, dengan ruang kerja perusahaan, konsol berbasis peran, simulasi penggajian, dan aplikasi karyawan seluler. Semua data tetap di browser.
